# 0) Configuration

```{r}
cfg <- list(
  LOCAL_PATH = "/../environment/",
  WOA_PO2_FILE  = NULL,  # filled below
  WOA_TEMP_FILE = NULL,  # filled below

  # Penn-style tolerances
  T_TOL_C     = 2.0,
  O2_TOL_FRAC = 0.20,

  # FishBase DemersPelag groupings
  labels_epipelagic = c("pelagic", "pelagic-neritic", "pelagic-oceanic"),
  labels_demersal   = c("demersal", "bathydemersal"),

  # OBIS parallelism
  n_workers = 64,

  # Dummy L-W conversion
  a_dummy = 0.010,
  b_dummy = 3.00,

  # decade-centered mass bins
  K_FLOOR = -10,
  K_CEIL  = 10,

  # pO2–T binning (high-res for saving)
  PT_bin_T  = 0.5,  # °C
  PT_bin_O2 = 0.5  # kPa
)

PATH <- paste0(here(), cfg$LOCAL_PATH)
cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE  <- paste0(PATH, "data_out/woa18_all_pO2_kPa_an01.csv")
cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE <- paste0(PATH, "data/woa18_95A4_t00an01.csv")

out_dir <- here("data_out", "OBISwoaFishBase")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

plan(multisession, workers = cfg$n_workers)
```


# 1) Helpers: grid + binning + saving + plotting

```{r}
snap_1deg_center <- function(x) round(x / 1) * 1 + 0.5

woa_wide_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("X"), names_to = "depth_m", values_to = value_name) %>%
    mutate(depth_m = as.numeric(sub("^X", "", depth_m)))
}

make_decade_centered_bins <- function(mass_g, k_floor = -10, k_ceiling = 10) {
  lg <- log10(mass_g)
  lg <- lg[is.finite(lg)]
  if (length(lg) == 0) {
    k_min <- k_floor; k_max <- k_ceiling
  } else {
    k_min <- max(floor(min(lg)), k_floor)
    k_max <- min(ceiling(max(lg)), k_ceiling)
  }
  ks <- seq(k_min, k_max, by = 1)
  edges <- 10^seq(k_min - 0.5, k_max + 0.5, by = 1)
  list(breaks = edges, labels = paste0("10^", ks, " g"))
}
```


```{r}
get_fishbase_species <- function(labels, group_name, a_dummy, b_dummy) {
  fb_tbl("species") %>%
    transmute(
      sci_name = paste(Genus, Species),
      DemersPelag,
      Length,
      Saltwater
    ) %>%
    filter(Saltwater == 1, DemersPelag %in% labels) %>%
    mutate(
      mass_g = a_dummy * Length^b_dummy,
      group  = group_name
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(mass_g)) %>%
    distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

get_obis_one <- function(species) {
  tryCatch({
    x <- occurrence(species)
    if (!is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0) x %>% mutate(sci_name = species) else NULL
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

fetch_obis <- function(species_vec) {
  obis_list <- future_lapply(species_vec, get_obis_one)
  data <- bind_rows(obis_list)
  missing <- species_vec[which(vapply(obis_list, is.null, logical(1)))]
  list(data = data, missing = missing)
}
```


```{r}
# Efficient saving: prefer qs if installed, else saveRDS(xz)
save_obj <- function(x, path_no_ext) {
  if (requireNamespace("qs", quietly = TRUE)) {
    qs::qsave(x, paste0(path_no_ext, ".qs"))
    return(paste0(path_no_ext, ".qs"))
  } else {
    saveRDS(x, paste0(path_no_ext, ".rds"), compress = "xz")
    return(paste0(path_no_ext, ".rds"))
  }
}
```


```{r}
# Build pO2–T binned grids (counts) for later analysis
# Output is compact: one row per (group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin)
bin_PT_counts <- function(df, dT = 0.5, dO2 = 0.5,
                          T_range = c(0, 30), O2_range = c(0, 30),
                          weight_col = NULL) {
  # Define bin indices
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    mutate(
      T_bin  = floor((pmax(pmin(temperature, T_range[2]), T_range[1]) - T_range[1]) / dT) * dT + T_range[1] + dT/2,
      O2_bin = floor((pmax(pmin(po2_kPa,     O2_range[2]), O2_range[1]) - O2_range[1]) / dO2) * dO2 + O2_range[1] + dO2/2
    )

  if (is.null(weight_col)) {
    df2 %>%
      count(group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin, name = "n")
  } else {
    df2 %>%
      group_by(group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin) %>%
      summarize(n = sum(.data[[weight_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# -------- Aesthetic plotting (single workhorse) --------

scale_fill_blue_counts <- function(fill_title = "Occurrences",
                                   na.value = "white",
                                   guide = legend_bar_guide()) {
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#67A5CA", high = "#251A2D",
    trans = "log10",
    name = fill_title,
    na.value = na.value,
    guide = guide
  )
}

plot_PT_state_space <- function(df, bins = 30,
                                facet = c("grid", "wrap", "none"),
                                title = NULL,
                                xlim = c(0,30), ylim = c(0,30),
                                theme = theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)) {
  facet <- match.arg(facet)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = temperature, y = po2_kPa)) +
    geom_bin2d(aes(fill = after_stat(count)), bins = bins) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    scale_fill_blue_counts("Occurrences") +
    labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "pO2 (kPa)") +
    theme

  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + ggtitle(title)

  if (facet == "grid") {
    p <- p + facet_grid(group ~ mass_bin)
  } else if (facet == "wrap") {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 2)
  }
  p
}
```


# 2) Load WOA and prep helpers

```{r}
load_woa <- function(cfg) {
  woa_temp <- read.csv(cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE)
  woa_po2  <- read.csv(cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE)

  woa_temp_long <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_temp, "temperature")
  woa_po2_long  <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_po2,  "po2_kPa")

  woa_long <- full_join(woa_temp_long, woa_po2_long,
                        by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m"))

  # uniqueness per (cell, depth)
  woa_long <- woa_long %>%
    group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth_m) %>%
    summarize(
      temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
      po2_kPa     = mean(po2_kPa,     na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  woa_seafloor <- woa_long %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature) | is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>%
    summarize(zfloor = max(depth_m, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  list(woa_long = woa_long, woa_seafloor = woa_seafloor)
}
```


# 3) Species list + OBIS + processing into tO2_obis / tO2_obis_cell

```{r}
build_species_lookup <- function(cfg) {
  fb_epi <- get_fishbase_species(cfg$labels_epipelagic, "epipelagic", cfg$a_dummy, cfg$b_dummy)
  fb_dem <- get_fishbase_species(cfg$labels_demersal,   "demersal",   cfg$a_dummy, cfg$b_dummy)

  fb_all <- bind_rows(fb_epi, fb_dem) %>%
    distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  bins <- make_decade_centered_bins(fb_all$mass_g, cfg$K_FLOOR, cfg$K_CEIL)

  fb_all <- fb_all %>%
    mutate(
      mass_bin = cut(
        mass_g,
        breaks = bins$breaks,
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = FALSE,
        labels = bins$labels
      )
    )

  fb_all %>%
    select(sci_name, group, mass_g, mass_bin)
}

fetch_and_prep_obis <- function(sp_lookup) {
  res_obis <- fetch_obis(sp_lookup$sci_name)
  list(
    obis_raw = res_obis$data,
    missing  = res_obis$missing,
    obis = res_obis$data %>%
      transmute(
        sci_name = if_else(is.na(sci_name), scientificName, sci_name),
        LATITUDE = decimalLatitude,
        LONGITUDE = decimalLongitude,
        zmin = as.numeric(minimumDepthInMeters),
        zmax = as.numeric(maximumDepthInMeters)
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(LATITUDE), is.finite(LONGITUDE)) %>%
      left_join(sp_lookup, by = "sci_name") %>%
      filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(mass_bin)) %>%
      mutate(
        LATITUDE  = snap_1deg_center(LATITUDE),
        LONGITUDE = snap_1deg_center(LONGITUDE)
      )
  )
}

# Main processing: depth rules -> dedupe queries -> join WOA -> uncertainty -> tO2_obis & tO2_obis_cell
process_obis_to_combined <- function(obis, woa_long, woa_seafloor, cfg) {

  # Depth rules (Penn-like)
  obis2 <- obis %>%
    mutate(
      zmin = if_else(is.na(zmin) & !is.na(zmax), zmax, zmin),
      zmax = if_else(is.na(zmax) & !is.na(zmin), zmin, zmax)
    ) %>%
    left_join(woa_seafloor, by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE")) %>%
    mutate(
      zmin = if_else(is.na(zmin) & is.na(zmax), 0, zmin),
      zmax = if_else(is.na(zmax) & is.na(zmin), zfloor, zmax)
    ) %>%
    select(-zfloor) %>%
    filter(is.finite(zmin), is.finite(zmax), zmax >= zmin)

  # Deduplicate env queries (big speedup)
  obis_q <- obis2 %>%
    distinct(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, zmin, zmax, group, mass_bin, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Join WOA depths for each query, restrict to [zmin,zmax]
  obis_woa <- obis_q %>%
    inner_join(
      woa_long %>% select(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth_m, temperature, po2_kPa),
      by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    filter(depth_m >= zmin, depth_m <= zmax)

  # Penn-style central estimate + uncertainty per query
  env_q <- obis_woa %>%
    mutate(
      zc   = (zmin + zmax) / 2,
      dist = abs(depth_m - zc)
    ) %>%
    group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, zmin, zmax, group, mass_bin) %>%
    arrange(dist, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarize(
      central_depth_m = first(depth_m),
      temperature     = first(temperature),
      po2_kPa         = first(po2_kPa),
      dT_max = max(abs(temperature - first(temperature)), na.rm = TRUE),
      dO2_max_frac = max(abs(po2_kPa - first(po2_kPa)) / pmax(first(po2_kPa), 1e-9), na.rm = TRUE),
      pass_uncertainty = (dT_max <= cfg$T_TOL_C) & (dO2_max_frac <= cfg$O2_TOL_FRAC),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tO2_obis <- obis2 %>%
    left_join(env_q, by = c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","zmin","zmax","group","mass_bin")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pass_uncertainty), pass_uncertainty) %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    mutate(
      temperature = pmax(pmin(temperature, 30), 0),
      po2_kPa     = pmax(pmin(po2_kPa,     30), 0),
      mass_bin    = droplevels(mass_bin)
    )

  stopifnot(!("depth_m" %in% names(tO2_obis)))

  tO2_obis_cell <- tO2_obis %>%
    distinct(group, mass_bin, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, central_depth_m, temperature, po2_kPa)

  list(obis2 = obis2, tO2_obis = tO2_obis, tO2_obis_cell = tO2_obis_cell, env_q = env_q)
}
```


# 4) Saving module

```{r}
# ---- 1) Save FULL tO2_obis as a single .RData ----
# (Loads later with: load(file.path(out_dir, "<name>.RData")) )
combined_rdata_file <- file.path(out_dir, "allOccurrences_OBISwoaFishBase.RData")
save(tO2_obis, file = combined_rdata_file, compress = "xz")

# ---- 2) Aggregate to pO2–T cells (same bins for tO2_obis + tO2_obis_cell) ----
# Recommended "fairly resolved" bins over 0–30 ranges:
PT_bin_T  <- 0.5  # °C
PT_bin_O2 <- 0.5  # kPa
T_range   <- c(0, 30)
O2_range  <- c(0, 30)

bin_PT_counts <- function(df, dT = 0.5, dO2 = 0.5,
                          T_range = c(0, 30), O2_range = c(0, 30)) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    mutate(
      # clamp to plotting range
      temperature = pmax(pmin(temperature, T_range[2]), T_range[1]),
      po2_kPa     = pmax(pmin(po2_kPa,     O2_range[2]), O2_range[1]),
      # bin centers
      T_bin  = floor((temperature - T_range[1]) / dT)  * dT + T_range[1] + dT/2,
      O2_bin = floor((po2_kPa     - O2_range[1]) / dO2) * dO2 + O2_range[1] + dO2/2
    ) %>%
    count(group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin, name = "n")
}

PT_grid_counts_from_combined <- bin_PT_counts(
  tO2_obis, dT = PT_bin_T, dO2 = PT_bin_O2, T_range = T_range, O2_range = O2_range
)

PT_grid_counts_from_tO2_obis_cell <- bin_PT_counts(
  tO2_obis_cell, dT = PT_bin_T, dO2 = PT_bin_O2, T_range = T_range, O2_range = O2_range
)

# ---- 3) Save PT grids as CSVs ----
csv_combined_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  sprintf("binOccurrences__dT_%0.2fC__dO2_%0.2fkPa__T_%d_%d__pO2_%d_%d.csv",
          PT_bin_T, PT_bin_O2, T_range[1], T_range[2], O2_range[1], O2_range[2])
)

csv_tO2_obis_cell_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  sprintf("binOccurrencesCell__dT_%0.2fC__dO2_%0.2fkPa__T_%d_%d__pO2_%d_%d.csv",
          PT_bin_T, PT_bin_O2, T_range[1], T_range[2], O2_range[1], O2_range[2])
)

readr::write_csv(PT_grid_counts_from_combined,      csv_combined_file)
readr::write_csv(PT_grid_counts_from_tO2_obis_cell, csv_tO2_obis_cell_file)

message("Saved:\n- ", combined_rdata_file,
        "\n- ", csv_combined_file,
        "\n- ", csv_tO2_obis_cell_file)
```


# 5) Run pipeline

```{r}
woa <- load_woa(cfg)
sp_lookup <- build_species_lookup(cfg)

obis_res <- fetch_and_prep_obis(sp_lookup)
writeLines(obis_res$missing, file.path(cfg$out_run, "missing_species.txt"))

proc <- process_obis_to_combined(
  obis = obis_res$obis,
  woa_long = woa$woa_long,
  woa_seafloor = woa$woa_seafloor,
  cfg = cfg
)

tO2_obis      <- proc$tO2_obis
tO2_obis_cell <- proc$tO2_obis_cell

# Save outputs
saved <- save_run_outputs(cfg, tO2_obis, tO2_obis_cell,
                          PT_bin_T = cfg$PT_bin_T,
                          PT_bin_O2 = cfg$PT_bin_O2)
print(saved)
```
